title: Feelings & support
goal: Ask a friend what's wrong, comfort and encourage them, apologise properly, congratulate and offer condolences, and link events with 'while', 'as soon as', 'after' and 'until'.
intro:
Being a real friend in Kannada means knowing what to say when things go wrong, and when they go right: asking ಏನಾಯ್ತು? and actually listening, saying ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ತಗೋಬೇಡ, saying sorry like you mean it, and demanding a ಪಾರ್ಟಿ when someone gets a promotion.

Two pieces of grammar carry this unit. First, most feelings in Kannada **happen to you**: ನನಗೆ ಬೇಜಾರಾಯ್ತು 'sadness happened to me', ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಅಳು ಬಂತು 'crying came to her'. Second, time clauses: **-ತಾ** 'while', **ತಕ್ಷಣ** 'as soon as', **ಮೇಲೆ** 'after' and **ತನಕ** 'until', which let you say 'call me as soon as you get home' and 'I'll stay until you feel better'.

vocab.note: ಮೂಡ್ ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ 'not in a good mood'; ಮೂಡ್ ಆಫ್ ಆಗಿದೆ 'feeling upset'.
The everyday word. ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ಆಗು 'to feel stressed' (it happens to you), ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ತಗೊ 'to stress yourself'.
The Kannada word, common in news and at work: ಕೆಲಸದ ಒತ್ತಡ 'work pressure'.
Normal subject: ನಾನು ಹೆದರಿದೆ 'I got scared'. ಹೆದರಬೇಡ 'don't be scared'. Noun: ಹೆದರಿಕೆ.
ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ 'alone'; ಒಂಟಿ ಅನ್ನಿಸ್ತಿದೆ 'I feel lonely'.
ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡು 'to think, to worry'. More everyday than the verb ಯೋಚಿಸು (unit 14).
ಧೈರ್ಯ ತಗೊ 'take heart'; ಧೈರ್ಯ ಹೇಳು 'to encourage, comfort'; ಧೈರ್ಯವಾಗಿ 'bravely, confidently'.
ಸಮಾಧಾನ ಆಯ್ತು 'I felt better / relieved'; ಸಮಾಧಾನ ಮಾಡು 'to console'; ಸಮಾಧಾನವಾಗಿರು 'stay calm'.
After the possessive: ನನ್ನ ಜೊತೆ 'with me', ಅಮ್ಮನ ಜೊತೆ 'with Mum'. Also ಜೊತೆಗೆ.

vocab.en: to take to heart (lit. to apply to oneself)
vocab.note: Spoken ಹಚ್ಕೊ-: ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹಚ್ಕೋಬೇಡ 'don't take it to heart'.
Spoken; the written word is ವರೆಗೆ. After the -ಓ form of a verb: ಬರೋ ತನಕ 'until (someone) comes'.
ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ಆಯ್ತು 'I felt at ease'; ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ಇಲ್ಲ 'I can't rest easy'.
ಕಣ್ಣು 'eye' + ನೀರು 'water'. ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಬಂತು 'tears came'.
ಕಾಳಜಿ ಮಾಡು 'to look out for'; ಹುಷಾರು, ನಿನ್ನ ಕಾಳಜಿ ತಗೊ 'take care of yourself'.
After a past form it means 'as soon as': ಬಂದ ತಕ್ಷಣ 'as soon as (you) come'. Also ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬಾ 'come at once'.
Formal: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ (in newspapers).
ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗು 'to pass'.
ಫೇಲ್ ಆಗು 'to fail'. Said 'fēl'.
Positive pride: ನಿನ್ನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ 'I'm proud of you'. Arrogance is ಅಹಂಕಾರ.
ಪ್ರಮೋಷನ್ ಸಿಗು 'to get a promotion' (it 'is found' by you).
With friends. Polite and in writing: ಅಭಿನಂದನೆಗಳು (unit 18).
Causative of ನೋಯು 'to ache'. ಮನಸ್ಸು ನೋಯಿಸು 'to hurt someone's feelings'.
Lit. 'saying (I) want it'. ಬೇಕಂತಲೇ 'deliberately' is stronger. Written ಬೇಕೆಂದು.
ಜಗಳ ಆಡು 'to quarrel'; ಜಗಳ ಆಯ್ತು 'we had a fight'.
From ಸಾಯು 'to die', which is blunt about people; say ತೀರಿಕೊಳ್ಳು.
The respectful verb. Spoken past: ತೀರಿಕೊಂಡ್ರು / ತೀರ್ಕೊಂಡ್ರು 'passed away'.
Also a common girl's name.

phrases.en: What happened? Why are you looking so down? (informal)
phrases.note: ಡಲ್ from English 'dull'. Polite: ಯಾಕೆ ಡಲ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದೀರ?

phrases.en: It'll all be fine. / Everything will sort itself out.
I'm here for you, don't worry. (informal)
If you need anything, tell me. (informal)
It was my fault, forgive me. (informal)
phrases.note: Lit. 'a mistake happened from me'. Polite: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ.

phrases.en: I didn't do it on purpose.

phrases.note: Lit. 'your memory is happening a lot (to me)'. Young people also say ತುಂಬಾ ಮಿಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
Good news means you owe your friends a treat.
Lit. 'pride happens about you'. Polite: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಗ್ಗೆ …

phrases.en: I'm so sorry to hear that.
phrases.note: The standard thing to say on hearing bad news, from a breakup to a death.

phrases.en: May their soul rest in peace.
phrases.note: -ಲಿ is the 'may it…' ending (unit 18). Often written as a message or status.

grammar.title: While, as soon as, after, until: -ತಾ, ತಕ್ಷಣ, ಮೇಲೆ, ತನಕ
grammar.body:
English puts a linking word ('while', 'as soon as', 'until') at the *start* of a clause. Kannada changes the **verb of the first clause** and puts the linking word *after* it. The time clause always comes first, and its verb never takes a person ending: the same form works for I, you, she or they.

**While doing (same person): -ಉತ್ತಾ, spoken -ತಾ.** Take the present stem: ಮಾಡು → ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ / **ಮಾಡ್ತಾ**, ಹೋಗು → **ಹೋಗ್ತಾ**, ಬರು → **ಬರ್ತಾ**, ಕುಡಿ → ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಾ / **ಕುಡೀತಾ**, ನೋಡು → **ನೋಡ್ತಾ**. ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡೀತಾ ಮಾತಾಡೋಣ 'let's talk over coffee'. Doubled, it means 'as it went on': ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ 'as we talked and talked'. With **-ಏ + ಇರು** it means 'keep on doing': ಅಳ್ತಾನೇ ಇದ್ದಾಳೆ 'she just keeps crying'.

**While / when (different people, or a background situation)**: use the -ಆಗ form from unit 19: ನಾನು ಅಡುಗೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅವಳು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ಳು 'she called while I was cooking'.

**As soon as: past relative form + ತಕ್ಷಣ.** The past relative form is the past stem + -ಅ, with no ending for the person: ಬಂದ, ಹೋದ, ಮಾಡಿದ, ಕೇಳಿದ, ಆದ, ಗೊತ್ತಾದ, ಮುಗಿದ. ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು 'call as soon as you get home'. (ಬಂದ ಕೂಡಲೇ means the same and is a little more formal.)

**After: past relative form + ಮೇಲೆ**, run together in speech: ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ → **ಬಂದ್ಮೇಲೆ**, ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ → **ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ**. ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ 'after lunch'. It also means 'since' for a state that began then: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮೋಷನ್ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ 'since he got the promotion'. **Before** is the -ಓಕೆ form + ಮುಂಚೆ: ಹೋಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ 'before going'.

**Until: -ಓ form + ತನಕ** (written: -ಉವ + ವರೆಗೆ). The -ಓ form is the spoken future relative form you know from ಬರೋ, ಹೋಗೋ: ಬರು → **ಬರೋ ತನಕ** / ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ, ಆಗು → **ಆಗೋ ತನಕ**, ಮುಗಿ → **ಮುಗಿಯೋ ತನಕ**, ಸಿಗು → **ಸಿಗೋ ತನಕ**.

**The trap:** English often thinks of 'until' negatively ('I can't relax until he calls' = 'as long as he hasn't called'). Kannada keeps the verb **positive**: ಅವನು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡೋ ತನಕ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, never ಮಾಡದ ತನಕ.

examples.en: Come on, let's talk as we walk.
I came running as soon as I found out.
I'll come to your place after work.

examples.native: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸರಿ ಆಗೋ ತನಕ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೇಲೇ ಇರು
examples.roman: ellā sari āgō tanaka namma manēlē iru
examples.en: Stay at our place until everything's sorted out.

examples.native: ನಾನು ಅಡುಗೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ ಅವಳು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ಳು
examples.roman: nānu aḍuge māḍtiddāga avaḷu phōn māḍidḷu
examples.en: She called while I was cooking.

grammar.title: Feelings that happen to you: ನನಗೆ ಬೇಜಾರಾಯ್ತು, ಅಳು ಬಂತು
grammar.body:
In English you *are* sad or you *get* angry. In Kannada most feelings **happen to** you: the person who feels takes the dative **-ಗೆ** (ನನಗೆ, ನಿನಗೆ, ಅವನಿಗೆ, ಅವಳಿಗೆ, ಅವರಿಗೆ, ನಮಗೆ) and the feeling itself is the subject of **ಆಗು** 'to happen' or **ಬರು** 'to come'. So the verb is always the 'it' form (ಆಯ್ತು, ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ, ಬಂತು), never the 'I' or 'she' form. You met this with illness in unit 9 (ನನಗೆ ಜ್ವರ ಬಂದಿದೆ) and with ಖುಷಿ ಆಯ್ತು in unit 14; here is the full picture.

**With ಆಗು** (states that come over you): ಬೇಜಾರು 'sadness, upset', ಖುಷಿ, ಭಯ, ಟೆನ್ಶನ್, ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ, ನಾಚಿಕೆ 'embarrassment', ಸಮಾಧಾನ 'relief', ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ, ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ, ನೆನಪು 'memory'. Tenses: ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ 'is happening (now)', ಆಯ್ತು 'happened', ಆಗುತ್ತೆ 'happens (usually)', ಆಗ್ತಿತ್ತು 'was happening'. Often written as one word: ಬೇಜಾರಾಯ್ತು, ನೆನಪಾಗ್ತಿದೆ.

**With ಬರು** (things that well up from inside): ಕೋಪ 'anger', ಅಳು 'crying', ನಗು 'laughter', ನಿದ್ದೆ 'sleep', ಕಣ್ಣೀರು 'tears'. ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಅಳು ಬಂತು 'she started crying', ನನಗೆ ನಗು ಬಂತು 'I couldn't help laughing', ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬರ್ತಿಲ್ಲ 'I can't sleep'.

**Missing someone** works the same way: (ನನಗೆ) ನಿನ್ನ ನೆನಪಾಗ್ತಿದೆ 'I miss you', lit. 'your memory is happening to me'. Young people also say ಮಿಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀನಿ.

**Doing it to yourself.** When a feeling is something you *let* yourself do, especially when telling someone not to, use **ಮಾಡ್ಕೊ** or **ತಗೊ** with a normal subject: ಬೇಜಾರು ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಬೇಡ 'don't be upset', ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ತಗೋಬೇಡ 'don't stress', ಕೋಪ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾಳೆ 'she's sulking / cross with us'. And some feelings are ordinary verbs: ನಾನು ಹೆದರಿದೆ 'I got scared', ಅವನು ಅತ್ತ 'he cried'.

**The trap:** ನಾನು ಭಯ or ನಾನು ಕೋಪ ಬಂದೆ are wrong; say ನನಗೆ ಭಯ ಆಯ್ತು, ನನಗೆ ಕೋಪ ಬಂತು. (You will hear ನಾನು ಬೇಜಾರಾಗಿದ್ದೀನಿ 'I'm feeling low' in speech, but the dative pattern is never wrong.)

examples.en: I felt relieved after seeing the result.

examples.native: ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಿದ್ದೆ, ತುಂಬಾ ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಆಯ್ತು
examples.roman: ellara munde bidde, tumbā nāchike āytu
examples.en: I fell over in front of everyone, so embarrassing.
Don't be cross, I was only joking.

dialogue.title: Over coffee in Jayanagar
dialogue.setting: Karthik has gone quiet for a week. Ananya drags him to a darshini in Jayanagar 4th Block to find out why.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ಏನಾಯ್ತು ಕಾರ್ತಿಕ್? ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಎತ್ತಲ್ಲ, ಮುಖ ನೋಡಿದ್ರೆ ಡಲ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದೀಯ.
lines.roman: ēnāytu kārtik? phōn māḍidre ettalla, mukha nōḍidre ḍal āgiddīya.
lines.en: What's going on, Karthik? You don't pick up when I call, and you look so down.

lines.speaker: Karthik
lines.native: ಏನ್ ಹೇಳ್ಲಿ... ಕೆಲಸ ಹೋಯ್ತು. ಕಂಪನೀಲಿ ಐವತ್ತು ಜನನ್ನ ತೆಗೆದು ಹಾಕಿದ್ರು.
lines.roman: ēn hēḷli... kelasa hōytu. kampanīli aivattu jananna tegedu hākidru.
lines.en: What can I say... I lost my job. The company let fifty people go.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ಅಯ್ಯೋ! ಯಾವಾಗ? ನನಗೆ ಮೊದಲೇ ಯಾಕೆ ಹೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲ?
lines.roman: ayyō! yāvāga? nanage modalē yāke hēḷalilla?
lines.en: Oh no! When? Why didn't you tell me before?

lines.speaker: Karthik
lines.native: ಸೋಮವಾರ. ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಮುಗಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕರೆದು ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು. ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಆಯ್ತು, ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಹೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
lines.roman: sōmavāra. mīṭiṅg mugida takṣaṇa karedu hēḷidru. nāchike āytu, yārigū hēḷalilla.
lines.en: Monday. They called me in and told me right after the meeting. I felt embarrassed, so I didn't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಚಿಕೆ ಏನಿದೆ? ನಿನ್ನ ತಪ್ಪಲ್ಲ. ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹಚ್ಕೋಬೇಡ.
lines.roman: idaralli nāchike ēnide? ninna tappalla. manassige hachkōbēḍa.
lines.en: What's embarrassing about it? It's not your fault. Don't take it to heart.

lines.speaker: Karthik
lines.native: ಗೊತ್ತು, ಆದ್ರೂ ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಮನೆ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ, ಲೋನ್... ರಾತ್ರಿ ನಿದ್ದೆನೇ ಬರ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
lines.roman: gottu, ādrū ṭenshan āgutte. mane bāḍige, lōn... rātri niddenē bartilla.
lines.en: I know, but I still get stressed. Rent, the loan... I can't sleep at night.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ನೋಡು, ನಿನ್ನಂಥ ಡೆವಲಪರ್‌ಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಸಿಗೋದು ಕಷ್ಟ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಹೊಸ ಕೆಲಸ ಸಿಗೋ ತನಕ ನಾನಿದ್ದೀನಿ.
lines.roman: nōḍu, ninnantha ḍevalaparge kelasa sigōdu kaṣṭa alla. hosa kelasa sigō tanaka nāniddīni.
lines.en: Look, it's not hard for a developer like you to find work. Until you find something new, I'm here.

lines.speaker: Karthik
lines.en: Really? So what do I do now?

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ನಮ್ಮ ಆಫೀಸಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಓಪನಿಂಗ್ ಇದೆ. ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನಿನ್ನ ರೆಸ್ಯೂಮ್ ಕಳಿಸು, ನಾನು ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್‌ಗೆ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: namma āphīsalli eraḍu ōpaniṅg ide. manege hōda takṣaṇa ninna resyūm kaḷisu, nānu myānējarge koḍtīni.
lines.en: There are two openings at my office. Send me your CV as soon as you get home, and I'll pass it to my manager.

lines.speaker: Karthik
lines.native: ಥ್ಯಾಂಕ್ಸ್ ಕಣೇ. ನಿನ್ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹಗುರ ಆಯ್ತು.
lines.roman: thyāṅks kaṇē. nin jote mātāḍida mēle manassu svalpa hagura āytu.
lines.en: Thanks, really. I feel a bit lighter after talking to you.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ಅದಕ್ಕೇ ಅಲ್ವಾ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಇರೋದು? ಈಗ ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿ, ತಣ್ಣಗಾಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ.
lines.roman: adakkē alvā phreṇḍs irōdu? īga kāphi kuḍi, taṇṇagāgōke muñche.
lines.en: Isn't that what friends are for? Now drink your coffee before it goes cold.

culture:
Friends in Bengaluru comfort each other in a very Kannada way: by feeding you (ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ? is often the first question), by dragging you out for coffee, and with the little address words **ಕಣೋ** (to a guy) and **ಕಣೇ** (to a girl), which soften anything: ಥ್ಯಾಂಕ್ಸ್ ಕಣೇ, ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ತಗೋಬೇಡ ಕಣೋ. They are warm and only for people you're close to; never use them with elders or strangers.

Saying sorry: ಸಾರಿ is for small things. For something that really hurt, say ನನ್ನಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಾಯ್ತು 'it was my mistake', and to an elder use ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ; some people will touch an elder's feet to make up after a real wrong. Good news means a treat: if you pass an exam, get a job or a promotion, friends will immediately ask ಪಾರ್ಟಿ ಯಾವಾಗ? and family will hand out sweets.

When someone dies, people visit the family's home in the first days without being invited, sit quietly, say little more than ಕೇಳಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಬೇಜಾರಾಯ್ತು and offer help. Don't bring gifts or sweets, and avoid bright colours. Messages and WhatsApp statuses say ಅವರ ಆತ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಸಿಗಲಿ or simply 'RIP' / ಓಂ ಶಾಂತಿ.

tip.title: Feelings happen to you
tip.body:
- The person feeling takes **-ಗೆ** (ನನಗೆ, ಅವನಿಗೆ) and the feeling is the subject: ನನಗೆ ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ **ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ** 'I'm stressed'.
- **ಆಗು** for states: ಬೇಜಾರು, ಖುಷಿ, ಭಯ, ಟೆನ್ಶನ್. **ಬರು** for what wells up: ಕೋಪ, ಅಳು, ನಗು, ನಿದ್ದೆ.
- The verb is the 'it' form: ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಕೋಪ **ಬಂತು**, not ಬಂದಳು.

sentences.en: I'm really stressed.
I'm not in a good mood today.
Why did she get angry?
There's a lot of pressure at work.
I get scared being on my own.
Don't be scared, nothing's going to happen.
He's so stressed he can't sleep.

sentences.native: ಮನೇಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ, ತುಂಬಾ ಒಂಟಿ ಅನ್ನಿಸ್ತಿದೆ.
sentences.roman: manēli obbaḷē iddīni, tumbā oṇṭi annistide.
sentences.en: I'm home on my own, I feel really lonely. (woman speaking)
What happened? Some problem at the office?

sentences.native: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ನನಗೆ ನಗು ಬಂತು.
sentences.roman: avana mātu kēḷi nanage nagu bantu.
sentences.en: I couldn't help laughing at what he said.

tip.title: Talking to a friend: do, don't, be
tip.body:
- With friends use the **ನೀನು** command, the bare stem: **ಹೇಳು**, **ಬಾ**, **ತಗೋ**.
- **Don't** = infinitive + **-ಬೇಡ**: ಅಳ**ಬೇಡ**, ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ತಗೋ**ಬೇಡ**. To someone you'd call ನೀವು: **-ಬೇಡಿ**.
- **Be …** = -ಆಗಿ + **ಇರು**: ಧೈರ್ಯವಾಗಿ**ರು** 'be strong', ಸಮಾಧಾನವಾಗಿರು 'stay calm'.

sentences.en: Don't cry, I'm with you.
Don't overthink it, go to sleep.
Take heart, you'll manage it.
Don't take what he said to heart.
Calm down a bit, I'll get you some water.
It'll all be fine, please don't worry. (polite)

sentences.native: ಅಮ್ಮನ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ಆಯ್ತು.
sentences.roman: ammana jote mātāḍida mēle samādhāna āytu.
sentences.en: I felt better after talking to Mum.

sentences.native: ಈ ಸಲ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಸಲ ನೋಡೋಣ.
sentences.roman: ī sala āgalilla, paravāgilla. mundina sala nōḍōṇa.
sentences.en: It didn't work out this time, never mind. We'll see next time.
Don't sit on your own, come with us.
Nothing will happen, stay strong. (polite)

tip.title: While -ತಾ, until ತನಕ
tip.body:
- **While doing** (same person): stem + **-ತಾ** (written -ಉತ್ತಾ): ಮಾಡ್**ತಾ**, ಹೋಗ್**ತಾ**, ಕುಡೀ**ತಾ**.
- **Until**: the -ಓ form + **ತನಕ**: ನೀನು ಬರೋ **ತನಕ** 'until you come'. Written: ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ.
- Trap: no 'not' with until: ಅವನು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡೋ ತನಕ, never ಮಾಡದ ತನಕ.

sentences.native: ನೀನು ಹುಷಾರಾಗೋ ತನಕ ನಾನು ಇಲ್ಲೇ ಇರ್ತೀನಿ.
sentences.roman: nīnu huṣārāgō tanaka nānu illē irtīni.
sentences.en: I'll stay right here until you're better.

sentences.native: ಅವನು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡೋ ತನಕ ನನಗೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.
sentences.roman: avanu phōn māḍō tanaka nanage nemmadi illa.
sentences.en: I can't rest easy until he calls.
Come, let's talk over coffee.

sentences.native: ಅವಳು ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಅಳೋಕೆ ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ಳು.
sentences.roman: avaḷu mātāḍtā mātāḍtā aḷōke shuru māḍidḷu.
sentences.en: As she talked, she started to cry.
Tears came to his eyes.

sentences.native: ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಂಟೆ ಆದ್ರೂ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು.
sentences.roman: ēnādrū bēkādre rātri eṣṭu gaṇṭe ādrū phōn māḍu.
sentences.en: If you need anything, call me, however late at night it is.
Thanks for caring.

sentences.native: ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು.
sentences.roman: manege hōgtā avanige ondu phōn māḍu.
sentences.en: Give him a call on your way home.

sentences.native: ಅಮ್ಮ ಬರೋ ತನಕ ಮಗು ಅಳ್ತಾನೇ ಇತ್ತು.
sentences.roman: amma barō tanaka magu aḷtānē ittu.
sentences.en: The baby kept crying until Mum came.
Don't look at your phone while you eat.

tip.title: As soon as ತಕ್ಷಣ, after ಮೇಲೆ
tip.body:
- **As soon as** = past form + **ತಕ್ಷಣ**: ಬಂದ **ತಕ್ಷಣ**, ಗೊತ್ತಾದ ತಕ್ಷಣ.
- **After / since** = past form + **ಮೇಲೆ** (spoken ಬಂದ್ಮೇಲೆ, ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ).
- The past form is just ಬಂದ, ಮಾಡಿದ, ಆದ, ಮುಗಿದ: no ending for the person, whoever does it.
tip.pattern: ರಿಸಲ್ಟ್ ಬಂದ + ತಕ್ಷಣ  ·  ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ + ಮೇಲೆ

sentences.native: ರಿಸಲ್ಟ್ ಬಂದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನನಗೆ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು.
sentences.roman: risalṭ banda takṣaṇa nanage phōn māḍu.
sentences.en: Call me as soon as the result comes out.
As soon as I heard the news, I told Mum.
You got the promotion? Congrats!
Let's meet after work.

sentences.native: ನಿನ್ನ ರಿಸಲ್ಟ್ ನೋಡಿ ನಮಗೆಲ್ಲಾ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ಆಯ್ತು.
sentences.roman: ninna risalṭ nōḍi namagellā hemme āytu.
sentences.en: We were all so proud when we saw your result.
I'll throw a party as soon as I pass.

sentences.native: ಒಂದು ಸಲ ಫೇಲ್ ಆದ್ರೆ ಏನಾಯ್ತು? ಮತ್ತೆ ಬರೆ.
sentences.roman: ondu sala phēl ādre ēnāytu? matte bare.
sentences.en: So what if you failed once? Take it again.
I'll tell you as soon as I know.

sentences.native: ಪ್ರಮೋಷನ್ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನು ಸಿಗೋದೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.
sentences.roman: pramōṣan sikkida mēle avanu sigōdē illa.
sentences.en: Since he got his promotion, we never get to see him.

tip.title: Sorry that sounds sincere
tip.body:
- **ಸಾರಿ** is for small things. For something real: **ನನ್ನಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಾಯ್ತು** 'it was my mistake'.
- 'Forgive me': **ಕ್ಷಮಿಸು** to a friend, **ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ** to anyone you call ನೀವು.
- 'Not on purpose': **ಬೇಕಂತ** + negative past: ಬೇಕಂತ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ.
- Accepting: ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಬಿಡು 'it's fine, forget it'.

sentences.en: I only said that yesterday because I was angry, sorry.
I wasn't late on purpose.
Forgive me if I hurt you.
Sir, it was my mistake, I'm sorry.

sentences.native: ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಬಿಡು, ನಾನು ಆಗಲೇ ಮರೆತು ಬಿಟ್ಟೆ.
sentences.roman: paravāgilla biḍu, nānu āgalē maretu biṭṭe.
sentences.en: It's fine, forget it, I've already forgotten about it.
The two of us had a fight.
Enough fighting, come on, let's go for a coffee.
He didn't hurt you on purpose.
Since leaving Bengaluru I've been missing you all.
Sorry, I won't do it again.

tip.title: Condolences: short and plain
tip.body:
- Say little: **ಕೇಳಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಬೇಜಾರಾಯ್ತು** 'I was so sorry to hear it'.
- For the person who died use respectful plural forms: ಅವರು **ತೀರಿಕೊಂಡ್ರು**, not ಸತ್ತ.
- Use **ನೀವು** with the family, even a friend's parents: ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಹೇಳಿ.
- **ಅವರ ಆತ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಸಿಗಲಿ** 'may their soul rest in peace'.

sentences.en: His grandmother passed away last night.
I was so sorry to hear the news. How are you holding up?
May God give their soul peace.

sentences.native: ಅಪ್ಪನ ಸಾವಿನ ನಂತರ ಅಮ್ಮ ಒಂಟಿ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
sentences.roman: appana sāvina nantara amma oṇṭi āgiddāre.
sentences.en: Since Dad died, Mum has been lonely.
I'd gone to comfort the family.

sentences.native: ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಹೇಳಿ, ಸಂಕೋಚ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಬೇಡಿ.
sentences.roman: ēnādrū sahāya bēkādre hēḷi, saṅkōcha māḍkōbēḍi.
sentences.en: If you need any help, just say, don't hesitate. (polite)

sentences.native: ಸಾವಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ನನಗೆ ಅಳು ಬಂತು.
sentences.roman: sāvina suddi kēḷi nanage aḷu bantu.
sentences.en: I cried when I heard he had died.
Give him a bit of time.
Let's go to their house tomorrow morning.
